LESSON: THE INSPIRED WORD OF GOD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Holy Bible
Topic 2.1: The Inspired Word of God

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about The Inspired Word of God. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should you respect the Holy Bible? 2. Why is it important to know the books in the Holy Bible?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. handle the Holy Bible with respect as the inspired word of God,
2. identify the books in the Old and New Testament,
3. role play naming some books in the Bible,
4. recite Isaiah 49:16 and desire to read the Holy Bible always. The learner is guided to: Holy Bible, Bible with respect, containing books in the Old and New Testament, the Old and the New Testament, Holy Bible. you respect the Holy Bible? important to know the books in the Holy Bible? ε

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about The Inspired Word of God.
2. Explain The Inspired Word of God to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: sing a song related to respecting the Holy Bible,
4. Show that you can: handle the Holy Bible with respect as the inspired word of God,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Inspired Word of God. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why should you respect the Holy Bible? 2. Why is it important to know the books in the Holy Bible?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Sing a song related to respecting the Holy Bible,
2. In pairs, observe and read charts containing books in the Old and New Testament,
3. Sing a song about the books in the Holy Bible. 1.
